mapper.sql: select cpvc_llave as llaveTabla ,cpvc_documento as documento ,cpvc_campo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,cpvc_transaccionregistro as transaccionRegistro ,cpvc_transaccioninactivo as transaccionInactivo ,cpvc_estado as estado from pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp a
mapper.select: update pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp set cpvc_documento = #{documento}, cpvc_campo = #{campo}, cpvc_valortext = #{valorText}, dpvc_valorfecha = #{valorFecha}, cpvc_valoropcion = #{valorOpcion}, cpvc_valorauxiliar = #{valorAuxiliar}, mpvc_valornumero = #{valorNumero}, cpvc_transaccionregistro = #{transaccionRegistro}, cpvc_transaccioninactivo = #{transaccionInactivo}, cpvc_estado =#{estado}
mapper.sql: select cpvc_llave as llaveTabla ,cpvc_documento as documento ,cpvc_campo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,cpvc_transaccionregistro as transaccionRegistro ,cpvc_transaccioninactivo as transaccionInactivo ,cpvc_estado as estado from pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp a
mapper.select: select cpvc_llave as llaveTabla ,cpvc_documento as documento ,cpvc_campo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,cpvc_transaccionregistro as transaccionRegistro ,cpvc_transaccioninactivo as transaccionInactivo ,cpvc_estado as estado from z_pvc_pedidoventacaracteristica where cpvc_documento = #{documento} and cpvc_estado ='A'

select cpvc_llave as llaveTabla ,cdpc_nombre as campo ,cdpc_llave as transaccionRegistro ,cpvc_documento as documento ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,cdpc_formato as estado from pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp a inner join documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp on (cpvc_campo = cdpc_llave and cdpc_estado = 'A') inner join propiedad_ppdp on (cppd_campo = cdpc_llave and cppd_propiedadvalor = 'PROP_104' and cppd_estado = 'A') where cpvc_estado ='A' and cpvc_documento in (#{item.llaveTabla}) order by ndpc_orden

select cdpc_codigo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,cdpc_formato as estado from pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp a, documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp where cpvc_campo = cdpc_llave and cpvc_documento = #{documento} and cpvc_estado ='A' order by ndpc_orden

select cpvc_llave as llaveTabla ,cpvc_campo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,null as estado from pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp a inner join documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp on (cdpc_llave = cpvc_campo and cdpc_estado = 'A' and cdpc_formato ='Z') inner join propiedad_ppdp on (cppd_campo =cdpc_llave and cppd_estado ='A' ) inner join propiedadvalordefinido_pvdp on (cppd_propiedadvalor = cpvd_llave and cpvd_codigo = 'PROCESO_GESTIONAR_ESTADOS' and cpvd_origen = 'C') where cpvc_documento =#{documento} and cpvc_estado = 'A' union select 'CAMPO_HEREDADO' as llaveTabla ,cdpc_llave as campo ,crit_campo as valorText ,null as valorOpcion ,crit_plantilla as valorAuxiliar ,null as estado from pedidoventa_pdvp inner join documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp on (cdpc_plantilla = cpdv_plantilla and cdpc_estado = 'A') inner join propiedad_ppdp param_bpm on (param_bpm.cppd_campo = cdpc_llave and param_bpm.cppd_estado = 'A' and param_bpm.cppd_propiedadvalor = 'PROP_37') inner join propiedad_ppdp param_herencia on (param_herencia.cppd_campo = cdpc_llave and param_herencia.cppd_estado = 'A' and param_herencia.cppd_propiedadvalor = 'PROP_33') inner join relacioninterna_ritp on (crit_propiedad = param_herencia.cppd_llave and crit_estado = 'A') where cpdv_llave = #{documento}
inner join documentoplantillacaracteristica_dpcp on ( cdpc_llave = cpvc_campo and cdpc_estado = 'A') where cpvc_documento = #{nombreDocumento} and cpvc_estado = 'A' and cdpc_formato = 'B'

select cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,cpvc_documento as documento ,cpdv_plantilla as valorAuxiliar ,cpdv_estadoexpediente as estado ,(select cpes_nombre from procesoestado_pesp where cpes_llave = cpdv_estadoexpediente) as transaccionRegistro from propiedad_${sqlFuncionCalculo} (#{campoId}, array[#{item.valorOpcion}]null) inner join pedidoventa_pdvp on (cpdv_llave = cpvc_documento)

select cdpf_codigo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText from propiedad_ppdp inner join relacioninterna_ritp on (crit_propiedad = cppd_llave and crit_estado = 'A' and crit_plantilla = #{plantilla}) inner join campo_documento cp_principal on (cp_principal.cdrc_documento = #{documento} and cp_principal.cpvc_campo = crit_campo ) where cppd_llave = #{propiedad} union select cp_detalle.cdpf_codigo as campo ,cp_detalle.cpvc_valortext as valorText from propiedad_ppdp inner join relacioninterna_ritp on (crit_propiedad = cppd_llave and crit_estado = 'A' and crit_plantilla != #{plantilla}) inner join campo_documento cp_principal on (cp_principal.cdrc_documento = #{documento}) inner join campo_documento cp_detalle on (cp_detalle.cdrc_documento = cp_principal.cpvc_valoropcion and crit_campo = cp_detalle.cpvc_campo ) where cppd_llave = #{propiedad}
union select cp_principal.cdpf_codigo as campo ,cp_principal.cpvc_valortext as valorText from propiedad_ppdp inner join relacioninterna_ritp on (crit_propiedad = cppd_llave and crit_estado = 'A' and crit_plantilla != #{plantilla}) inner join campo_documento cp_principal on (cp_principal.cdrc_documento = #{modificador}) where cppd_llave = #{propiedad}
where cpvc_documento in (#{itemA.valorOpcion}) and cpvc_estado ='A' and cpvc_campo in (#{itemB.campo})

foreach.if: select cpvc_llave as llaveTabla ,cpvc_documento as documento ,cpvc_campo as campo ,cpvc_valortext as valorText ,dpvc_valorfecha as valorFecha ,cpvc_valoropcion as valorOpcion ,cpvc_valorauxiliar as valorAuxiliar ,mpvc_valornumero as valorNumero ,cpvc_estado as estado from pedidoventacaracteristica_pvcp a where cpvc_documento = #{itemA.valorOpcion} and cpvc_estado ='A' and cpvc_campo in (#{itemB.campo})
